newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE December gilts set new contract high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE December gilts set new contract high.

text.p: LIFFE December gilt rose to a new contract high at 109-03 on Tuesday, replacing the old record of 109-02, traders said.
After hitting the new top, the contract quickly recoiled and was was trading 15/32 higher on the day at 109-02 by 1421 GMT.
Global debt futures received a boost earlier after the September survey from the U.S. National Association of Purchasing Management came in weaker than expected.
December gilts' last contract record was set on September 27.
